The '''2009–10 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team''' represented [[North Carolina State University|NC State University]] in the [[2009–10 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2009–10 men's college basketball season]]. The team were coached by [[Sidney Lowe]] and played their home games at the [[RBC Center]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina|Raleigh]], [[North Carolina|NC]]. The Wolfpack is a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. 

The 2009–10 season marked the 100th season of Wolfpack men's basketball.<ref>[http://www.gopack.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=9200&ATCLID=204831606 ]{{Dead link|date=September 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} Wolfpack Opens 100th Basketball Season</ref> NC State finished the season 20–16 (5–11 in ACC play). The team advanced to the quarterfinals of the [[2010 ACC men's basketball tournament]] before losing to [[2009–10 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Georgia Tech]]. They were invited to the [[2010 National Invitation Tournament]] and advanced to the second round before being defeated by [[2009–10 UAB Blazers men's basketball team|UAB]].
